# Launch image

Generated from `Icon-App-1024x1024@1x.png` with the iOS icon corner radius
applied, at 120pt (120/240/360px). Regenerate with the snippet in
`docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` if the app icon changes — these files are
derived artwork, not originals. The original is `design/app_icon.svg`.

The surrounding colour is the `LaunchBackground` colour set, which carries
light and dark variants matching the app's Material 3 surface. Keep them in
step with `app/lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart` so the launch screen hands
over to the first frame without a flash.
